description_en: Deactivates blackhole filtering status for a single protected IP address
description_zh: 为单个受保护IP解除黑洞状态
name: DeleteBlackhole

parameters.help_en:
The protected IP address for which you want to deactivate blackhole filtering status.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html to query all IP assets protected by Anti-DDoS Origin instances and their protection status, including whether the IP addresses are in blackhole filtering status
parameters.help_zh:
要解除黑洞状态的受保护IP。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html查询所有受DDoS原生防护实例保护的IP资产及IP的防护状态（IP是否处于黑洞状态）
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
